name: iw4
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (IW4, 64-bit rebuild)
note: Addresses from the shipped iw4sp.exe (2026-09-22 build, x64; .text is plain code, only the SteamStub .bind section is packed), flattened (file offset == RVA). Stream primitives found by disassembly (load_stream, file_read, advance, load_string(_ptr), markers, dead block 2), the rest read from the neighbours of Load_Stream.

ghidra.program_note: analysed on the 2026-09-14 iw4sp.exe, an earlier build than the profile's: never reuse its addresses here

rva_note: file_read(dst, n, 0) is the inflate read (hooked, never run). Load_XString (load_string) reads one byte at a time through file_read (stream.byte_strings); load_string_ptr is the script-string variant (then SL_GetString, engine code). alloc is DB_AllocStreamPos(align mask): pos = (pos + mask) & ~mask; 0xdc060 is `mov ecx, 3; jmp alloc`. insert_ptr: push(3), align 8, 8 bytes, pop. resolve / resolve_deref: v - 1 = block << 28 | offset (sar 0x1c). advance is DB_IncStreamPos. Load_Stream on block 2 (runtime) memsets and advances: no file read.

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAsset(flag): Load_Stream(flag, varXAsset, 16), varXAssetHeader = varXAsset + 8, then Load_XAssetHeader (0xe6850) compares the type and calls the type's Ptr loader with its var set

release.note: 2026-10-01: the emulator consumes 52/52 zones to their last byte, emuwalk 52/52 identical, C++ == Python 52/52; 41 zones are under release-check's 256 MB measure cap

zone_header.note: the stream starts at size; the 0x20-byte XAssetList before it (after the 0x28-byte XFile)

zone_load.note: the tail of DB_LoadXFile (0xdb7f0): the 0x28-byte XFile, the 0x20-byte XAssetList raw-read into a static (varXAssetList = it); under push(3) the script strings (0xe2350); under push(3) the asset array allocated (0xdc060), Load_Stream-ed, and each entry dispatched with varXAsset = &list[i]
